proposed_comments.title: Honor the package thumbnail relationship before heuristics

confidence.rationale: The current implementation applies filename heuristics before package relationships, while the package relationship is the authoritative thumbnail declaration.

proposed_comments.title: Accept XML whitespace in transform attributes

confidence.rationale: ST_Transform values are XML whitespace-separated; the current separator array accepts only literal spaces.

proposed_comments.body:
### Accept all XML whitespace in transforms
**Severity:** `medium`

`ST_Transform` is whitespace-separated, not space-separated. Include tabs, carriage returns, and line feeds so valid XML formatting does not silently invalidate the transform.

```suggestion
        private static readonly char[] TransformSeparators = { ' ', '\t', '\r', '\n' };
```

proposed_comments.title: Do not enlarge fitting thumbnails or retain disposed stream backing

confidence.rationale: The current scale calculation can enlarge already-fitting images, and returning a bitmap backed by a disposed source stream risks later image access failures.

proposed_comments.title: Use extension-aware PNG output

confidence.rationale: String replacement changes unrelated path components containing '.3mf' and emits BMP data even though the native host expects the new PNG output.

proposed_comments.title: Log the resolved state without dereferencing an optional setting

confidence.rationale: The existing trace and error paths dereference an optional setting value, which is absent when policy supplies the state during upgrades.

proposed_comments.body:
### Use the resolved state for policy-controlled modules
**Severity:** `medium`

When policy provides the state, the setting value can be absent. Capture the prior applied state and log `module_new_state` instead of dereferencing `toggle` in the state-change and failure telemetry paths.

proposed_comments.title: Close the supported-version XML element

confidence.rationale: The current XML string element is missing its closing angle bracket, so the policy resource file is not well formed.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the policy resource XML well formed
**Severity:** `high`

Close this string element so Group Policy can parse the resource file and load the supported-version metadata.

```suggestion
      <string id="SUPPORTED_POWERTOYS_0_101_0">PowerToys version 0.101.0 or later</string>
```

proposed_comments.title: Bound all untrusted package parsing and geometry work

confidence.rationale: The parser consumes untrusted ZIP/XML/image data and the current implementation lacks the package-wide size, XML, relationship, decoded-pixel, vertex, triangle, instance, and resolution bounds needed to make those operations bounded.

proposed_comments.body:
### Bound untrusted package parsing and geometry work
**Severity:** `critical`

The provider runs in response to Explorer opening an untrusted file. Apply package-wide limits before decompression and XML/image materialization, disable DTD and external entity resolution, and share vertex, triangle, decoded-pixel, model-byte, instance, and object-resolution budgets across the complete package. The limits must be enforced on actual bytes read rather than only trusting ZIP central-directory lengths.

proposed_comments.title: Resolve the designated root and Production Extension graph safely

confidence.rationale: The current loader treats every model part as a root, resolves relationship targets loosely, and does not fully resolve package-root Production Extension component references with cycle and depth protection.

proposed_comments.body:
### Resolve only the intended model graph
**Severity:** `high`

Use the package-level 3D-model relationship to select the root part, with an explicit compatibility fallback only when that relationship is absent. Match relationship types exactly, normalize and percent-decode URI targets, reject external targets, and resolve Production Extension `p:path` references relative to the package root. Filter core-namespace objects and components, preserve an explicit empty `<build/>`, support direct-mesh fallback only when no build exists, and enforce cycle, depth, part-count, instance, and resolution budgets while composing transforms and unit scales.

proposed_comments.title: Make the managed/native handoff failure-safe

confidence.rationale: The managed and native layers need coordinated stream, process, handle, HRESULT, timeout, output initialization, bitmap-alpha, and cleanup behavior for Explorer-hosted untrusted input.

proposed_comments.body:
### Make the managed/native handoff failure-safe
**Severity:** `high`

Handle non-seekable input by buffering it once, check every stream read and process-launch result, initialize output pointers and alpha values before returning, enforce a finite worker timeout, close process and stream handles on every path, and return a failure HRESULT when no bitmap was produced. Validate the generated bitmap and preserve alpha explicitly instead of assuming BMP loading retains transparent pixels.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the existing WinRT ABI slot order

confidence.rationale: Adding a static WinRT method in the middle of the existing interface changes the ABI slot of every following method and can break already-compiled consumers.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the existing WinRT ABI slot order
**Severity:** `high`

Append the new `GetConfiguredThreeMfThumbnailsEnabledValue` method after the existing final accessor rather than inserting it between established methods. The generated static interface is an ABI contract, so existing slots must remain unchanged.

proposed_comments.title: Add focused coverage for the new package and policy paths

confidence.rationale: The feature needs focused coverage for relationship-free thumbnail fallback, transforms and unit conversion, component graphs, policy callbacks, Explorer activation/error markers, and fuzz-target resource exhaustion.

proposed_comments.body:
### Cover the security and compatibility boundaries
**Severity:** `medium`

Add focused tests for relationship-free `thumbnail*` and `Metadata/` fallback, exact relationship matching and URI normalization, malformed XML and oversized entries, empty builds, cross-part components, cycle/depth and geometry budgets, whitespace-separated transforms, unit conversion, non-seekable streams, output-path derivation, policy-controlled settings callbacks, and Explorer success/failure log markers. Keep the fuzz target linked to the shared SDL work item and avoid catching memory-exhaustion failures as ordinary invalid input.
